Guide dogs are a great boon to the partially sighted.
Seesaw (v.) to change repeatedly from one emotion, situation, etc. to
another and then back again （情緒、局勢等）搖擺不定，不斷反覆，交替
His mind seesawed between hope and despair all through those weeks.
Extinct (adj.) not now existing 滅絕的；絕種的；消失的
There is concern that the giant panda will soon become extinct.

questions.stem: A newly discovered feature of dog body language may surprise pet owners and dog experts. When dogs feel positive about something or someone, their tails wag more to the right side. When they have negative feelings, their tail wagging is more to the left. According to the passage, when dogs see their owners, they_________.

options.B: wag their tails to the right
options.D: wag their tails to the left

questions.explain:
段落意思: 新發現的狗肢體語言特徵可能會讓寵物主人和狗專家感到驚訝。當
狗對某事或某人感到積極時，它們的尾巴會更向右擺動。 當他們有負面情緒
時，他們的尾巴搖擺更偏向左側。所以根據段落意義，狗見到主人時尾巴會
更向右擺動
Feature: (n.) a typical quality or an important part of something
特色，特徵，特點
The town's main features are its beautiful mosque and ancient marketplace.
Wag. (v.) to move from side to side or up and down, especially quickly and
repeatedly, or to cause this to happen （使）（尤指尾巴或手指）擺動，搖
The little dog's tail wagged in delight.

questions.stem: The financial crisis around the world has already made a lot of people in every industry go bankrupt or pushed them back to square one. According to the passage, many people have gone bankrupt or have to ______.
questions.explain:
句義: 全球金融危機已經讓各行各業的很多人破產或重新再來。
Back to square one: If you are back to square one, you have to start working
on a plan from the beginning because your previous attempt failed
completely 回到原點
If this doesn't work we're back to square one

questions.stem: The European Union introduced a “blue card” plan aimed at attracting highly skilled immigrants. Similar to the “green card” program for foreign workers in the US, the European plan is designed to bring in an additional 20 million workers from Asia, Africa and Latin America in the next two decades. According to the passage, the European plan will mostly likely welcome _______________
questions.explain:
段落翻譯:歐盟推出了一項旨在吸引高技能移⺠的“藍卡”計劃。 與美國的外國
工人“綠卡”計劃類似，歐洲計劃在未來二十年內從亞洲、非洲和拉丁美洲額外
引進 2000 萬工人。 根據文章，歐洲計劃很可能會歡迎 __________
a. 藍領工人
b. 非技術工人
c. 社會工作者
d 高科技工作者
根據段落意思, 答案是d 高科技工作者
Introduce (v.) to put something into use, operation, or a place for the first
time
採用；引進
Apple has sold many millions of iPods since the product was introduced in
2001.
Immigrant (n.) a person who has come to a different country in order to live
there permanently （外來的）移⺠
Illegal immigrants are sent back across the border if they are caught.
Additional (adj.) extra 外加的，附加的；額外的；另外的
There will be an extra charge for any additional passengers.
High-tech (adj.) using the most advanced and developed machines and
methods
高科技的
This weapons system is an affordable, hi-tech solution.
